hero_image.description: Colorful, 3D shapes arranged in a fun design. Perfect for the landing page hero abstract playful vibe.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on bright colored buttons (like white text on orange/pink) meets contrast requirements. If needed, darken the button background slightly.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the Nunito font for the body and Fredoka for all headings. Import them via Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement the Duolingo-style 'pushable' buttons using bottom borders (e.g., border-b-4) that disappear when active/pressed.
Cards and inputs should have heavily rounded corners (rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Do NOT use gamification elements (streaks, points, etc.) as the core product is non-gamified, but KEEP the playful, clean visual style.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts, heavily customize Shadcn components for forms, dialogs, etc., to match the heavily rounded, thick-bordered style.
Implement the 'Matching Pool with Waiting Animation' as a fun, bouncing 3D or CSS animation.
The 24h follow window should have a bold, large, clean countdown timer.
